subject: design/routing-evidence-v1
statement: Routing evidence is one closed `routing-evidence/v1` event family stored as one immutable content-addressed file per logical event on a dedicated fetched git evidence ref. Writers validate the full existing reducer state, compare-and-swap the ref head, and exact-read the newly reachable event; only a durably observed `routing_resolved` event authorizes task claim or reviewer launch, and every resolved attempt must later append exactly one bounded outcome.
